newsitem.title: SPAIN: Metrovacesa 1996 gp net profit 4.71 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Metrovacesa 1996 gp net profit 4.71 bln ptas.

text.p: Full 1996 results for Spanish property group Metrovacesa (in billions of pesetas):
Metrovacesa said that an increase in corporate tax payments, which rose 99 percent, were due to modifications in the rate. In homogenous terms, net profit would have risen 16.5 percent.
The firm continued a prudent depreciation policy, deferring 662 million pesetas in taxes over 35 years.

At a press conference chairman Fernando Vara said he was optimistic on the outlook for the sector, adding that in the first few months of 1997 business had been better than expected, with substantial potential demand anticipated over the next five years.
Vara added: "The market's growth rate will be moderate at first and foreseeably will accelerate if the expectations of economic improvement are confirmed."
However he did not expect prices to boom as in the second half of the 1980s.
